notes: Current source surface library has 27 assets and 13 unique Poly Haven texture sources; selected images are original bytes unless a map is explicitly marked as project-authored.
Three derived plain cloth colors are project-authored; original Poly Haven fabric_pattern_07 normal and roughness supply measured weave. Their original printed diffuse is disconnected.
Project-authored mathematical maps contain no street-view or reference-image pixels. Poly Haven photographic maps are separately credited as CC0 scans.
The environment uses authored Chongqing motifs and OSM plan references, not a photographic survey or 1:1 façade reproduction.
R7 gray plaster is quiet plastered_wall_04; localized weathering overlays provide age. Previous whole-wall moss, colored floor paint and high-contrast stone remain only as unselected archival inputs.
R7 scanned branch mappings are baked into valid primary UV in the adopted prepared library; details are in scanned_assets/branch_uv_repair.json.
R7 ordinary pavement reuses neutral concrete_floor_worn_001 at 4.5 m scene repeat, while yard and stairs use 3 m. Previous brown-gray checkerboard paving is retained only as an archival input.
R7 plaster_ochre is a retained legacy key now using the same unchanged gray plastered_wall_04 scan at 4 m repeat; plaster_grey uses 3.2 m. No color modification or third surface download.
refinement: After visual review, analytic grey brick was replaced by an acquired photographic color map. The original procedural fallback remains reproducible in author_surfaces.py.
